G4863.definition: συν-άγω; to gather or bring together: of things, Jhn.6:12-13; before εἰς, Mat.3:12, al.; ἐκεῖ, Luk.12:18; ποῦ, Luk.12:17; συναγαγὼν πάντα (sc. εἰς ἀργύριον; see Field, Notes, 68, MM, xxiv), having sold off all: Luk.15:13; of persons, Jhn.11:52; esp. of assemblies, Mat.2:4, Jhn.11:47, Act.14:27, al. Pass., to be gathered or come together: Mat.22:41, Mrk.2:2, Luk.22:66, al.; before ἐπί Mrk.5:21, Act.4:27; πρός…

G4864.definition: συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ; prop., a bringing together; 1. of things, ; (a) a gathering in of harvest; (b) a collection of money. ; 2. Of persons, ; (a) a collecting, assembling (Polyb.); (b) an assembly (MM, xxiv; Deiss., LAE, 101 ff.): Rev.2:9 3:9; esp. of a Jewish religious assembly, a synagogue: Luk.12:11, Act.9:2, al.; of a Christian assembly, Jas.2:2. By meton., of the building in which the assembly is held, a…

G4892.definition: (σύν + ἕδρα, a seat)  ; 1. a council (Plat., Xen., al.; LXX; in π., σ. τ. πρεσβυτέρων, Deiss., BS, 156): of a local Jewish tribunal, Mat.10:17, Mrk.13:9. ; 2. The supreme ecclesiastical court of the Jews, the Sanhedrin (i.e. Talmudic סַנְהֵדְרִין = συνέδριον): Mat.5:22 26:59, Mrk.14:55 15:1, Luk.22:66, Act.5:21, 27 5:34, 41 6:12, 15 22:30 23:1, 6 23:15, 20 23:28 (WH, R, mg., om.) Act.24:20 of a meeting of the…

G4851.definition: συμ-φέρω; 1. trans. to bring together: with accusative of thing(s), Act.19:19. ; 2. Intrans., and mostly impers., συμφέρει, it is expedient, profitable or an advantage: 1Co.6:12 10:23, 2Co.8:10; with inf. (M, Pr., 210), Mat.19:10, Jhn.18:14; with dative, before ἵνα (Bl., § 69, 5), Mat.5:29-30 18:6, Jhn.11:50 16:7. Ptcp., ςυμφέρων, profitable: 1Co.12:7; pl., Act.20:20; (οὐ σ. sc. ἐστιν; = οὐ συμφέρει; cf. Thuc., iii…
renderings: Although there is nothing to gain

G4816.definition: συλ-λέγω; to bring together, collect, gather up: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.13:28-30; pass., Mat.13:40; with accusative, before ἀπό, Mat.7:16; id. before ἐκ, Mat.13:41, Luk.6:44; before εἰς, Mat.13:48.†; (AS)

G4873.definition: συν-ανά-κειμαι; to recline with or together at table: Mat.14:9, Mrk.6:22, Luk.7:49 14:15; with dative of person(s), Mat.9:10, Mrk.2:15, Luk.14:10.†; (AS)

G4824.definition: (σύμβουλος),  ; a word of the Græco-Roman period (of. Lat. consilium, and see Deiss., BS, 238) = cl. συμβουλία (Arist., Xen.), ; 1. counsel: σ. λαμβάνειν, Mat.12:14 22:15 27:7 28:12; διδόναι, Mrk.3:6 (ποιεῖν, Rec.); ποιεῖν, Mrk.15:1 (ἑτοιμάζειν, WH, mg.). ; 2. By meton., a council (4Mac, l.with א; συνέδριον, AR): Act.25:12 (see MM, xxiv).†; (AS)

G4846.definition: συν-πνίγω (Rec. συμπ-), ; to choke: of thronging by a crowd, Luk.8:42. Fig., of seed, τ. λόγον, Mat.13:22, Mrk.4:7, 19, Luk.8:14.†; (AS)

G4885.definition: συν-αυξάνω; to cause to increase or grow together. Pass., to grow together: Mat.13:30 (Xen., al.).†; (AS)

G4814.definition: to talk or converse with another, (New Testament) (ML)

G4856.definition: συμ-φωνέω, -ῶ,; prop., to agree in sound, be in harmony (Plat., Arist.). Metaphorical, ; (a) to agree with, agree together: Luk.5:36; with dative of thing(s), Act.15:15; before περί, Mat.18:19; pass., with dative of person(s), συνεφωνήθη ὑμῖν, Act.5:9; (b) to agree as to a price (Polyb., Diod.): with dative of person(s), genitive pret., Mat.20:13; before μετά . . . ἐκ, Mat.20:2.†; (AS)

G4868.definition: συν-αίρω; to take up together: σ. λόγον (of which there are several exx. in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 118 f.; MM, i, xxiv; M, Pr., 160), to settle accounts, Mat.18:23-24; before μετά, C. genitive of person(s), Mat.25:19.†; (AS)

G4889.definition: σύν-δουλος, -ου, ὁ; a fellow-servant: Mat.18:28-33 24:49; of servants of the same divine Lord, Col.1:7 4:7, Rev.6:11; so of angels, Rev.19:10 22:9.†; (AS)

G4801.definition: συν-ζεύγνυμι; (Rec. συζ-),  ; to yoke to­gether: metaphorically, of union in wedlock, Mat.19:6, Mrk.10:9.†; (AS)

G4862.definition: prep. with dative, ; expressing association, fellowship and inclusion. It gradually gave way to μετά, with genitive (cf. LS, see word; Bl., §41, 3), and is therefore comparatively infrequent in NT, being rare in Mat.4, Mrk.6, Jhn.3, and elsewhere (exx. Jas.1:11, 2Pe.1:18) only in Lk (Gosp. and Ac) and Paul. With, together with: of companionship and association, Luk.2:13, Jhn.21:3, Act.10:23, al.; εἶναι σύν τινι…

G4823.definition: 1. to advise, counsel , Lat. consulere alicui, with dative pers. et infinitive, to advise one to do a thing, (Herdotus Historicus), etc. ; 2. without the infinitive, ς. τινί τι (Herdotus Historicus); ς. τι to recommend a measure, (Herdotus Historicus), attic:—;Pass., τὰ συμβουλευόμενα the advice given , (Xenophon Historicus) ; 3. absolute to advise, give advice , (Sophocles Tragicus); ὁ συμβουλεύων or -εύσας, an…

G4815.definition: συλ-λαμβάνω; 1. with accusative, to bring together, collect. ; 2. to seize, take: with accusative of person(s), as a prisoner, Mat.26:55, Mrk.14:48, Luk.22:54, Jhn.18:12, Act.1:16 12:3; pass., Act.23:27; mid., in sense of act., Act.26:21; σ. ἄγραν ἰχθύων, Luk.5:9. ; 3. C. dative of person(s), to take part with, assist, succour; mid., in same sense: Luk.5:7, Php.4:3. ; 4. Of a woman, to conceive: absol., Luk.1:24…

G4802.definition: συν-ζητέω; (Rec. συζ-), -ῶ,  ; 1. to search or examine together (Plat.). ; 2. In NT (and π., see MM, xxiii; also in MGr., see Kennedy, Sources, 155), to discuss, dispute: Mrk.1:27 12:28, Luk.24:15; before quæst. indir., Mrk.9:10; with dative of person(s), Mrk.8:11 Act.6:9; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Mrk.9:14, 16, Act.9:29; id. before quæst. indir., Luk.22:23.†; (AS)

G4818.definition: συν-λυπέω; (Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ,  ; to make to grieve with (Arist.). Pass., to be moved to grief by sympathy: before ἐπί, with dative, Mrk.3:5.†; (AS)

G4870.definition: συν-ακολουθέω, -ῶ; to follow along with, accompany: with dative of person(s), Mrk.14:51, Luk.23:49; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), Mrk.5:37.†; (AS)

G4849.definition: 1. a drinking-party, symposium , (Theognis Elegiacus), etc. ; 2. the room in which such parties were given, drinking-room , (Lucian) (ML)

G4848.definition: συν-πορεύομαι; (Rec. σνμπ-),  ; 1. to journey together (Plat., al.): with dative of person(s), Luk.7:11 14:25 24:15. ; 2. to come together: Mrk.10:1 (Plut., al.).†; (AS)

G4819.definition: συμ-βαίνω; 1. to stand with the feet together. ; 2. to come together, come to terms. ; 3. Of events, to come to pass, happen: with dative of person(s), Mrk.10:32, Act.3:10 20:19, 1Co.10:11, 1Pe.4:12, 2Pe.2:22; absol., τὰ σνμβεβηκότα, Luk.24:14 (cf. 1Ma.4:26); with accusative and nf., Act.21:35.†; (AS)

G4880.definition: συν-απο-θνήσκω; to die with or together: Mrk.14:31, 2Co.7:3 (see Meyer, in l), 2Ti.2:11.†; (AS)

G4872.definition: συν-ανα-βαίνω; to go up with: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., Mrk.15:41, Act.13:31.†; (AS)

G4820.definition: συν-βάλλω; (Rec. συμ-),  ; to throw together, hence, ; (a) of speech (before λόγους, Eur., al.), to discuss, confer (sc. λόγους): with dative of person(s), Luk.11:53, WH, mg., Act.17:18; before πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Act.4:15; (b) to reflect, consider, ponder: ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Luk.2:19; (with) to meet with, fall in with: Act.20:14; in hostile sense, εἰς πόλεμον, with dative (εἰς μάχην, Polyb.), Luk.14:31; (d) mid., to…

G4826.definition: Simeon (so always AV; RV in Luk.2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 1. the son of Jacob (Gen.29:33): Rev.7:7. ; 2. An ancestor of our Lord: Luk.3:30 ; 3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Luk.2:25, 34. ; 4. One surnamed Niger: Act.13:1. ; 5. The apostle Peter: Act.15:14, 2Pe.1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†; (AS)

G4811.definition: (σῦκον, φαίνω),  ; to act the συκοφάντης (on conjectures as to the origin of the term, see LS, see word), to accuse falsely (Aristoph., Xen., al.): Luk.3:14 (R, mg.) Luk.19:8 (RV, exact wrongfully; but cf. Hatch, Essays, 89 ff., see also Field, Notes, 56 f.; MM, xxiv).†; (AS)

G4896.definition: σύν-ειμι; (εἶμι, to go), ; to come together: Luk.8:4.†; (AS)

G4855.definition: συν-φύω; (Rec. συμ-),  ; to cause to grow together. Pass., to grow together or with (Plat. al.): Luk.8:7.†; (AS)

G4845.definition: συν-πληρόω; (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ,  ; 1. to fill up completely (Thuc., of manning ships): of a ship filling with water, and by meton., of those on board, Luk.8:23. ; 2. to complete, fulfil: of time (Je, l.with, and see MM, xxiv), Luk.9:51, Act.2:1 (on the "durative inf.," see M, Pr., 233).†; (AS)

G4884.definition: συν-αρπάζω; "perfective " of ἁοπάζω (see M, Pr., 113), ; (a) to seize and carry away (so most commonly) : Act.27:15; (b) to seize and hold: Luk.8:29, Act.6:12 19:29.†; (AS)

G4895.definition: σύν-ειμι; (εἰμί to be),  ; to be with: Luk.9:18 (WH, mg., συνήντησαν), Act.22:11.†; (AS)

G4876.definition: συν-αντάω, -ῶ; to meet with: with dative of person(s), Luk.9:18, 37 22:10, Act.10:25, Heb.7:1, 10. Metaphorical, of events, to happen, befall (Ding. L., Plut., al.): Act.20:22.†; (AS)

G4878.definition: συν-αντι-λαμβάνομαι; to take hold with at the side for assistance; hence, to take a share in, help in bearing, and generally, help (with various constructions, see LXX, ll. with, Deiss., LAE, 83 f.): with dative, Luk.10:40, Rom.8:26.†; (AS)

G4858.definition: (σύμφωνος),  ; 1. symphony, music: Luk.15:25 ; 2. a musical instrument (Polyb., al.; Da, ll. with; v MM, xxiv).†; (AS)

G4807.definition: the mulberry tree ; (Lat. morus; cf. μόρον, 1Ma.6:34 *), ; the sycamine: Luk.17:6. (In LXX, σ. appears to represent the συκόμορος (see: συκομορέα), but St. Luke distinguishes between the two; see ICC, in l; DB, iv, 634.) †; (AS)

G4809.definition: συκο-μορέα (Rec. -μωραία, L, -μωρέα), -ας, ἡ, more commonly (so Aq., Sm., Psa.78:47, Isa.9:10) συκόμορος ; (σῦκον + μόρον, the black mulberry), ; a fig-mulberry, a sycamore: Luk.19:4 (cf. συκάμινος).†; (AS)

G4817.definition: συλ-λογίζομαι; 1. to compute. ; 2. to reason: Luk.20:5.†; (AS)

G4836.definition: συν-παρα-γίνομαι; (Rec. συμπ-),  ; 1. to come up or be present together: before ἐπί, Luk.23:48. ; 2. to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; 2Ti.4:16, Rec.).†; (AS)

G4867.definition: συν-αθροίζω; to gather together, assemble: with accusative of person(s), Act.19:25; pass., Act.12:12.†; ἀθροίζω ; (ἀθρόος, assembled in crowds, MM, VGT, see word; θρόος, a noise, tumult),  ; to Gather, assemble: Luk.24:33.†; (AS)

G4897.definition: συν-εισ-έρχομαι; to enter together: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., Jhn.6:22 18:15.†; (AS)

G4827.definition: συν-μαθητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ ; a fellow-disciple: Jhn.11:16 (on the use of συν- in such compounds as this, see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†; (AS)

G4871.definition: συν-αλίζω; to assemble with: Act.1:4 (EV, mg., eating with, but on this rendering and on the force of the Pres. ptcp. here, see Field, Notes, 110).†; (AS)

G4894.definition: συν-εῖδον irreg. aorist of συνοράω (see: εἶδον),; 1. to see together or at the same time (Arist., Xen.). ; 2. to see in one view, hence, of mental vision, to comprehend, understand (LXX, Polyb., Plut., al.) : Act.12:12 14:6 (on the related σύνοιδα, see see word).†; (AS)

G4886.definition: σύν-δεσμος, -ου, ὁ; (συνδέω),  ; that which binds together, a bond: of the ligaments of the body, Col.2:19. Metaphorical, σ. ἀδικίας, Act.8:23; τ. τελειότητος, Col.3:14; τ. εἰρήνης, Eph.4:3 (see Lft., Col., ll. with).†; (AS)

G4822.definition: συν-βιβάζω; (Rec. συμ-),  ; 1. to join or knit together, unite: Eph.4:16, Col.2:2 (but see infr.), Col.2:19. ; 2. to compare, consider, conclude (Plat.): Act.16:10. ; 3. to deduce, prove, demonstrate (Arist.): Act.9:22. ; 4. As in LXX ("translation Greek," = ἐμβιβάζω, metaphorically), to teach, instruct: 1Co.2:16 Act.19:33, R, mg. (also in Vg., Col.2:2, instructi, but see supr.).†; (AS)

G4844.definition: συμπόσιον, -ου, τό; (συμπίνω),  ; 1. a drinking party ; 2. By meton., of the party itself, the guests (Plut); pl., σ. σ. (colloq.; see M, Pr., 97), in parties or companies: Mrk.6:39.†; (AS)

G4838.definition: συν-παρα-λαμβάνω; (Rec. συμπ-),  ; to take along with: as a companion, with accusative, Act.12:25 15:37-38 (on the tenses, see M, Pr., 130), Gal.2:1.†; (AS)

G4860.definition: συμ-ψηφίζω; to reckon together, count up: Act.19:19.†; (AS)

G4898.definition: συν-έκδημος, -ου, ὁ; (ἔκδημος, abroad), ; a fellow-traveller: Act.19:29, 2Co.8:1.†; (AS)

G4843.definition: συν-περι-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-), ; 1. to enclose (Eze.5:3 (צוּר) *). ; 2. to embrace: with accusative of person(s), Act.20:10.†; (AS)

G4890.definition: (συντρέχω),  ; concourse, esp. of a riotous gathering: Act.21:30 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†; (AS)

G4893.definition: συν-είδησις, -εως, ἡ; (συνεῖδον),  ; 1. consciousness: with genitive obj., Heb.10:2, 1Pe.2:19. ; 2. In ethical sense, innate discernment, self-judging consciousness, conscience (Stoics and late writers): Rom.2:15 9:1, 1Co.10:29, 2Co.1:12 4:2 5:11, 1Ti.4:2, Heb.9:14; σ. ἀγαθή, Act.23:1, 1Ti.1:5 1:19, 1Pe.3:16 3:21; ἀσθενής, 1Co.8:7 8:10; ἀσθενοῦσα, 1Co.8:12; ἀπρόσκοπος, Act.24:16; καθαρά, 1Ti.3:9, 2Ti.1:3; καλή…

G4840.definition: συν-πάρειμι; (Rec. σνμπ-),  ; to be present together or with: with dative of person(s), Act.25:24.†; (AS)

G4837.definition: συν-παρα-καλέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, ; to call upon or exhort together (Plat.). Pass., to be strengthened or comforted with and among: Rom.1:12.†; (AS)

G4828.definition: συν-μαρτυρέω (Rec. συμμ-), -ῶ, ; to bear witness with: Rom.2:15; with dative, Rom.8:16; before ὅτι, Rom.9:1.†; (AS)

G4854.definition: σύμ-φυτος, -ον; (συμφύω, to make to grow together)  ; 1. congenital, innate (Plat., al.; 3Mac, l.with). ; 2. grown along with, united with: τ. ὁμοιώματι τ. θανάτου αὐτσῦ (see Field, Notes, 155 f.), Rom.6:5.†; (AS)

G4800.definition: συν-ζάω (Rec. συζ-), ; to live with: opposite to συναποθανεῖν, 2Co.7:3; of life in union with Christ, here and hereafter, Rom.6:8, 2Ti.2:11.†; (AS)

G4852.definition: σύν φημι (Rec. συμ-), ; to consent, confess: with dative, before ὅτι, Rom.7:16.†; (AS)

G4841.definition: συν-πάσχω; (Rec. συμπ-),  ; 1. to suffer together or with: Rom.8:17, 1Co.12:28. ; 2. to sympathize with (Plat., Arist.).†; (AS)

G4888.definition: συν-δοξάζω ; 1. to join in approving (Arist.). ; 2. In NT only, to glorify together: pass., Rom.8:17.†; (AS)

G4832.definition: σύμ-μορφος, -ον; (σύν, μορφή), ; 1. absol., similar (Luc.). ; 2. con­formed to: with dative, Php.3:21; with genitive, Rom.8:29 (see B1., § 36, 11; 37, 6).†; (AS)

G4879.definition: συν-απ-άγω; to lead away with or together (Ex, l.with). Pass., metaphorically (as συμπεριφέρομαι, see LS, see word), to be carried away with: with dative, Gal.2:13, 2Pe.3:17; of accommodating one­self to (EV, condescend to) things or persons (on the meaning, see ICC, in I.; Field, Notes, 163), Rom.12:16.†; (AS)

G4865.definition: συν-αγωνίζομαι ; to strive together with, to help (prop., of sharing in a contest): with dative of person(s) and of thing(s), Rom.15:30.†; (AS)

G4875.definition: συν-ανα-παύομαι; with dative of person(s), to lie down to rest with, sleep with. Metaphorical, to be refreshed in spirit with: Rom.15:32 (L, om.).†; (AS)

G4869.definition: συν-αιχμάλωτος, -ου, ὁ ; a fellow prisoner (prop., of a captive in war, see Lft., Col., 234): Rom.16:7, Col.4:10, Phm 23.†; (AS)

G4804.definition: συν-ζητητής (Rec. συζ-), -οῦ, ἁ ; (συνζητέω), ; a disputer, disputant: 1Co.1:20.†; (AS)

G4821.definition: συμ-βουλεύω; 1. to advise, counsel: with dative of person(s), Jhn.18:14; id. before inf., Rev.3:18. ; 2. Mid., to take counsel, consult: before ἵνα, Mat.26:4 ("reciprocal middle," see M, Pr., 157); with inf., Act.9:23.†; (AS)

G4874.definition: συν-ανα-μίγνυμι; (accusative to Bl., 8, -μείγνυμι),  ; to mix up together; pass., reflex, and metaphorically, to associate with (Plut., Ath., al.): 1Co.5:9 5:11, 2Th.3:14 (see M, Th., 117).†; (AS)

G4859.definition: (ούν, φωνή),  ; agreeing in sound. Metaphorical, harmonious, agreeing: ἐκ συμφώνου (for exx. from π., see Deiss., BS, 255), by agreement, 1Co.7:5.†; (AS)

G4829.definition: συν-μερίζω; (Rec. συμμ-),  ; to distri­bute in shares. Mid., to have a share in: 1Co.9:13 (Diod., al.).†; (AS)

G4857.definition: συμ-φώνησις, -εως, ἡ; (συμφωνέω), ; concord, agreement: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), 2Co.6:15.†; (AS)

G4842.definition: συν-πέμπω (Rec. συμπ-) ; to send together with: with accusative and dative, 2Co.8:22; id. before μετά, with genitive, 2Co.8:18.†; (AS)

G4813.definition: with accusative of person(s), to strip, plunder, spoil: 2Co.11:8.†; (AS)

G4882.definition: συν-απο-στέλλω; to send along with: with accusative, 2Co.12:18 (cf. MM, xxiv).†; (AS)

G4806.definition: συν-ζωο-ποιέω (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-, ; to make alive or quicken together with; metaphorically, of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, Eph.2:5; σὺν τ. Χ., Col.2:13.†; (AS)

G4891.definition: συν-εγείρω; to raise together: metaphorically, of the Christian's mystical resur­rection with Christ, Eph.2:6; pass., Col.2:12 3:1.†; (AS)
renderings: God raised us up with Christ

G4847.definition: συν-πολίτης (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ ; a fellow-citizen: pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opposite to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, Eph.2:19 (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†; (AS)

G4883.definition: συν-αρμολογέω, -ῶ; (ἁρμός, λέγω), = cl. συναρμόζω, ; to fit or frame together: of the parts of a building, Eph.2:21; of the members of the body, Eph.4:16 (Eccl.).†; (AS)

G4830.definition: συν-μέτοχος (Rec. συμμ-), -ον, ; partaking together with; as subst., ὁ σ., a joint partaker (with dative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): with genitive of thing(s), Eph.3:6; with genitive of person(s), Eph.5:7 (Arist.).†; (AS)

G4866.definition: συν-αθλέω, -ῶ ; = συναγωνίζομαι: with dative commod., Php.1:27; with dative of person(s), before ἐν, Php.4:3.†; (AS)

G4861.definition: σύν-ψυχος (Rec. συμ-), -ον ; (ψυχή), ; of one mind: Php.2:2.†; (AS)

G4833.definition: Pass. to be conformed to , τινι (New Testament) (ML)

G4831.definition: συν-μιμητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ ; a fellow-imitator: with genitive obj., Php.3:17 (see ICC, in l). Not elsewhere.†; (AS)

G4805.definition: σύν-ζυγος (Rec. ουζ-), or as WH, mg., Σύνζυγος, -ον ; (συνζεύγνυμι),  ; a yoke fellow. Prob., as proper name, Σ. γνήσιε, genuinely Synzygus, S. properly so-called, Php.4:3 (see ICC, Lft., in l; MM, xxiii).†; (AS)

G4812.definition: (σύλη, booty + ἄγω), ; to carry off as spoil, lead captive (θυγατέρα, Heliod., Aeth., 10, 35): metaphorically, Col.2:8.†; (AS)

G4853.definition: συμ-φυλέτης, -ου, ὁ; (σύν, φυλή; cf. σύμφυλος, Aq.: Zec.13:7; and see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.) ; a fellow-tribesman, fellow-countryman: 1Th.2:14 (see M, Th., in l, and Intr. liii). Not found elsewhere.†; (AS)

G4834.definition: συν-παθέω; (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ,  ; to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in: with dative of thing(s), Heb.4:15; dative of person(s), Heb.10:34 (Arist., Plut., al.).†; (AS)

G4881.definition: συν-απ-όλλυμι; to destroy with or together. Pass., to perish together (with): with dative of person(s), Heb.11:31.†; (AS)

G4887.definition: συν-δέω; (a) to bind together; (b) to bind together with: pass., Heb.13:3.†; (AS)

G4835.definition: (σύν, πάσχω)  ; 1. affected by like feelings, sympathetic: 1Pe.3:8. ; 2. exciting sympathy (Jb, l.with; Dion. H.).†; (AS)

G4899.definition: συν-εκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν ; chosen together with, co-elect: ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτή (on the meaning, see ICC, in l), 1Pe.5:13.†; (AS)
